description: Spell Attacks are permanently learned through appropriate magical training, scrolls, books, or other sources.

notes: Characters begin knowing the Spell Attacks granted by their Base Class and Subclass. These spells are included in the character's Base Character Value.
Starting spells do not occupy prepared Command Ability slots.
Additional Spell Attacks may be learned from appropriate magical scrolls or other sources.
These values are guidelines until the full Spell Catalogue is finalized.
A newly learned Spell Attack adds its listed Points to the character's battlefield value as permanent spell knowledge.

Reading or studying the scroll grants the spell permanently when its learning requirements are met. The scroll is normally consumed or otherwise expended during this process. The character does not need to continue carrying the original scroll.

knownSpellAttackRules: May be used during their appropriate combat phase.
Do not occupy Command Ability preparation slots.
